remediated_defects.title: Student Notification Lifecycle and Background Polling Unregistered
remediated_defects.description: Student dashboard did not request notification permissions upon login and failed to start background polling, preventing in-app notifications and unread badge updates.
remediated_defects.remediation: Integrated requestNotificationPermissions() and startInAppPolling(ApiClient()) within test-safe Builder callbacks in StudentDashboardScreen. 127/127 tests passed.

remediated_defects.title: Missing Student In-App Notification Bell & Terminal Screen
remediated_defects.description: Students had no visual UI element to view received announcements or unread badge counts, causing notification invisibility when OS push notifications were disabled.
remediated_defects.remediation: Added notification bell icon with live unread badge in student header card, and integrated Notifications menu drawer entry routing to FacultyNotificationHistoryScreen.

remediated_defects.title: Client Deep-Linking Missing Generic Notification Route Mappings
remediated_defects.description: Tapped notifications with data payload route=notifications or route=announcements failed to resolve, falling back to default screen without opening details.
remediated_defects.remediation: Added case notifications and case announcements route handlers in NotificationService.navigateForData().

remediated_defects.title: Blank and Whitespace-Only Notification Broadcast Ingestion
remediated_defects.description: Admin notification creation schema allowed whitespace-only title or body, resulting in blank system notifications.
remediated_defects.remediation: Added Pydantic @field_validator for title and body enforcing non-empty trimmed character requirements with HTTP 422 rejection.

remediated_defects.title: Duplicate Rapid Broadcast Spam Vulnerability
remediated_defects.description: Admins double-clicking the send button could broadcast identical announcements multiple times to entire campus cohorts.
remediated_defects.remediation: Added 10-second deduplication sliding window checking recent AuditLog records; subsequent identical sends are rejected or returned as DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED.

remediated_defects.title: Duplicate Scheduled Notification Injection Risk
remediated_defects.description: Multiple identical scheduled notification entries could be queued for the exact same audience and timestamp.
remediated_defects.remediation: Added query check for active PENDING scheduled notifications matching title, body, and audience before queuing duplicates.

remediated_defects.title: Multicast Per-Recipient Status Tracking Deficiency
remediated_defects.description: FCM multicast push returned aggregate counts without exposing which tokens succeeded and which failed, causing all database logs to be marked SENT even if specific tokens failed.
remediated_defects.remediation: Updated FCMService.send_multicast_push to return (successful_tokens, failed_tokens) and updated per-user NotificationLog.status accordingly.

remediated_defects.title: Firebase Configuration Project ID & Storage Bucket Alignment
remediated_defects.description: google-services.json referenced legacy cloud storage bucket instead of canonical go-on-f0b90 project identifier.
remediated_defects.remediation: Synchronized project_id to go-on-f0b90 and storage_bucket to go-on-f0b90.firebasestorage.app.
